generation_contract.positive_template: One {finish} {material} {form_factor} {object_type}, a household {category}: a tall slim upright loudspeaker column resting directly on the floor on a rectangular plinth, roughly five times taller than it is wide. The front baffle carries four exposed round drivers stacked on the vertical centerline: two large woofer cones low down, one midrange cone above them, and one small dome tweeter at the very top. The side and back panels are plain and flat with no controls and no cloth.
generation_contract.pose_guard_prompt: Render exactly one object, centered, resting stably on a flat neutral surface against a plain seamless light-gray background. Three-quarter product view from slightly above eye level so the front and one side are both visible. The entire object fits in frame with a clear margin on every side. Physically plausible real-world proportions and construction. Even studio lighting, soft shadow directly beneath the object only. No humans, no hands, no text, no logos, no labels, no screens showing content, no cables trailing out of frame, no reflections of surroundings, no additional objects, no cropping. This is a neutral reconstruction reference for image-to-3D, not an advertisement scene.
generation_contract.negative_prompt: human, hand, fingers, text, logo, watermark, label, sticker, multiple objects, duplicated object, cropped object, cut off, close-up detail shot, extreme perspective, fisheye, tilted camera, floating object, reflection of photographer, cluttered background, background furniture, scene environment, packaging box, advertisement layout, collage, split image, pair of speakers, stereo pair, two speakers, stacked speakers, speaker stand, tripod stand, wall bracket, subwoofer box, amplifier, receiver, turntable, cables, grille cloth over the drivers, removed front panel, exploded view, cutaway, short cabinet, tabletop speaker, single driver, two drivers, horizontal orientation, lying down
